intro: Five stages, in order. The story cannot be replayed, so stage 1 is about playing it once and playing it right: manual saves before big missions, choices made in the moment, and every missable flag checked before you move on. Everything after the story is free roam, so stages 2 to 5 can be done in any order — but this order wastes the least time. Early guides put the whole platinum at around 200 hours (PowerPyx) to 300 or more (Push Square).

stages.advice: Keep a manual save before every big mission. The game gives you 15 manual save slots — use them. Story missions cannot be replayed, so any trophy tied to a mission moment has to be earned in that moment. Make your choices when the story offers them; Actions Speak Louder tracks them. Do not rush past stranger icons that appear during the story — they open stage 2.
stages.goal: Finish the story: all 4 chapters, the final mission, and every named mission trophy.
stages.name: Story first — Chapters 1 to 4

stages.advice: Stranger strands are the side stories marked across the map. Each one ends in a finale that only happens once, so keep a manual save before each finale. Eight full strands earn the silver Strangers & Freaks; the five named finales are Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone. Bret's strand adds the Fair Game hunt. Explore after each chapter, because new stranger icons appear as the story opens the map.
stages.goal: Complete 8 stranger mission strands, including the 5 named finales and Bret's unique hunt.
stages.name: Strangers across Leonida
stages.time: Alongside and just after the story

stages.advice: Do this as one deliberate road trip, not in drips. Drive the whole map: coastline, interior, every settlement. At each new place, WAiNK It, look for cards, and sit in any vehicle type you have not logged. Buy garages as you can afford them and register vehicles to the Scooter Bros app as you go. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points — sweep them in one pass so none is left half-done.
stages.goal: 52 areas, 100 vehicles discovered, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK check-ins, 8 garages, 10 Scooter Bros registrations, 18 meditation spots.
stages.name: Explore and collect

stages.advice: This is the longest stage, so split it by mood: a driving day for stunts and races, a combat day for the shooting range and Gunslinger, a robbery day for vaults, trucks and gang operations. The shooting range is the hardest skill gate — practise one challenge at a time and come back to hard ones. Check the one-off feats (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Sneakthief, Capital Offense) before you start them: each needs a specific setup.
stages.goal: 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 20 race wins, 14 drone-race locations, 5 bank vaults, one of each gang's operations, 50 challenges, and the one-off feats.
stages.name: Activities, combat and robberies

stages.advice: Launder the take after every big robbery instead of sitting on marked bills, and spend on useful things — ammo, armour, vehicle upgrades — so the $100,000 goes toward something. Open the in-game completion checklist and finish the shortest categories first for momentum. When the counter hits 100%, A Long Road pops, and Vice Got a Price! follows immediately: you are a Leonida Legend.
stages.goal: Launder $250,000 of marked bills, spend $100,000 in shops, finish 50 challenges, hit 100% completion — then the platinum.
stages.name: Money, 100% and Platinum

title: Road to the Platinum
